items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: Harold, him and I have been like that since we married.

ctx.x: You got to do a good job, right?

ctx.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
ctx.x: Oh, my husband is a Jew. I would trade him for the golden world. Harold, him and I have been like that since we married. Remember, in the morning I make some laughs. The lady next girl tells me.
I proved that with the night that other girl I did.
